cs.t: Absolutely agreed.  Just got the AA Wireless dongle a couple weeks ago via an IndiGogo campaign and absolutely love it. The music is a bit choppy using the dongle, so for long trips, I still plug the phone in.  But when out running errands where I'm in and out of the car often, having Android Auto loaded by the time the car turns on with my phone still in my pocket is a game-changer.
